summary: Job 1358 restart images 04-06 were audited and rebuilt as an unsubmitted eight-image local O-H path. Original image 05 was replaced by six exact O-H waypoints; numeric, VTST, and visual continuity checks pass and the package awaits user review.

payload.objective: Obtain user structure review of the rebuilt local O-H bond-formation path between job 1358 restart images 04 and 06; do not submit a calculation yet.
current_evidence: Job 1358 restart images 04, 05, and 06 are individually collision-free and preserve C1-C2, C2-O, and C1-H48; the prior failure came from uneven adjacent motion rather than one invalid isolated structure.
Original image 05 was not retained. Images 04 and 06 bound a new local path with six exact O47-H49 waypoints at 2.45, 2.20, 1.95, 1.70, 1.45, and 1.25 A.
The rebuilt eight-image O-H sequence decreases strictly from 2.690028 to 1.136496 A and contains four local images in the 1.1-1.8 A review interval.
Maximum adjacent movable-atom RMSD is 0.049684 A, maximum single-atom step is 0.260817 A, maximum dist.pl value is 0.281056 A, and the minimum nonbonded separation is 1.45 A.
Atom order, cell, Fe 0-17 fixed mask, fixed coordinates, preserved adsorbate bonds, and sequential periodic branch pass.
Top and side visual review shows smooth O-H closure without framework inversion, fragmentation, surface penetration, or desorption; apparent top-view H wrapping is a periodic-display artifact.
The local boundaries are ML restart structures, not independently relaxed minima. The package is a kinematic predicted-path seed only and has no ML/VASP energy or force evidence.
payload.one_executable_step: Present the rebuilt local 04-to-06 path and its structure table to the user for acceptance or requested edits; do not upload or submit it.
payload.submission_boundary: No GPU, VASP, ML-CI, Dimer, frequency, retry, or barrier action is authorized by this construction review.
done_when: The user accepts the rebuilt local path or requests a concrete geometry change.
Any later execution receives separate explicit authority and a current hash-bound execution gate.
